text: The text analyses the phenomenon of fanfiction as a cultural practice capable of overflowing the limits imposed by the culture industry and canonical narratives. Drawing on Adorno and Horkheimer, Foucault, Badiou and Fisher, fanfiction is proposed as a form of critique that identifies and expands the links between power and knowledge in audiovisual fiction, opening up spaces of dissidence and imagination.
